Nicht die eine perfekte Stelle gefunden? Egal. Wir suchen ständig Leute wie Dich – für Rollen im Tiefbau, Rohrleitungs- und Netzbau, in der Infrastruktur und in der Energiewirtschaft. Bewirb Dich einmal bei uns, und wir bringen Dir die Vakanzen, die wirklich passen. Diskret, gezielt und für Dich als Kandidat kostenfrei.
Aufgaben
Wenn Du Dich bei uns in den Talentpool einträgst, läuft für Dich Folgendes:
Wir hören Dir erst zu, bevor wir Dir irgendetwas anbieten. Was kannst Du, was willst Du, was auf keinen Fall? Erst danach fangen wir an zu suchen.
Wir bringen Dir passende Rollen aus unserem Netzwerk – vom Bauunternehmen um die Ecke bis zum überregionalen Infrastruktur- und Netzbetreiber.
Du bewirbst Dich einmal – wir übernehmen den Rest. Kein Bewerbungs-Marathon, kein Streuen von Lebensläufen. Wir stellen Dich gezielt und diskret vor.
Dein Name bleibt geschützt. Wir sprechen Kunden erst mit Deinem OK an – Dein aktueller Arbeitgeber erfährt nichts.
Du bleibst im Pool, auch wenn's gerade nicht passt. Sobald eine Rolle reinkommt, die zu Dir passt, meldest Du Dich – oder wir bei Dir.
Qualifikation
Wir suchen Fachkräfte und Führungskräfte aus dem Bau- und Infrastrukturumfeld – egal, wo Du gerade auf der Leiter stehst. Zum Beispiel:
Rollen: Bauleiter (gn), Oberbauleiter (gn), Projektleiter (gn), Bauingenieur (gn), Kalkulator (gn), Polier (gn), Vorarbeiter (gn), Bautechniker (gn), Vermessungstechniker (gn), Geräteführer (gn), Netzmonteur (gn), Meister (gn) – und alles dazwischen.
Gewerke: Tiefbau, Rohrleitungsbau, Kanal- und Straßenbau, Erd- und Grundbau, Gleis-/Bahnbau, Kabel- und Leitungsbau, Netzbau (Strom, Gas, Wasser, Glasfaser), Freileitungs- und Anlagenbau, Energiewirtschaft.
Erfahrung: Vom soliden Praktiker (gn) mit Baustellen-Kilometern bis zum erfahrenen Baumanager (gn). Berufseinsteiger mit Fundament genauso willkommen wie Profis mit 25 Jahren auf dem Bau.
Deine Haltung: Du weißt, was Du kannst, und willst es an der richtigen Stelle einbringen. Du kommunizierst klar und stehst zu dem, was Du sagst.
Kein perfektes Profil? Bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir denken in Menschen und Baustellen, nicht in Häkchenlisten.

Wir kennen den Markt, nicht nur die Stellenbörse. JIRO ist auf Tiefbau, Infrastruktur und Energie im DACH-Raum spezialisiert – wir wissen, welche Rollen wo offen sind, auch die, die nie öffentlich ausgeschrieben werden.
Ehrlicher Austausch statt Vermittler-Blabla. Wir sagen Dir, wenn etwas nicht passt. Und wir sagen Dir warum.
Diskretion ist Standard, kein Extra. Deine Daten bleiben bei uns, Dein Wechselwunsch bleibt Deine Sache.
Für Dich als Kandidat entstehen keine Kosten. Unser Modell zahlen die Unternehmen – Du bekommst die Suche, die Vorbereitung und die Begleitung obendrauf.
Ein fester Ansprechpartner. Kein wechselndes Callcenter, sondern Menschen, die Deinen Fall kennen.
JIRO ist ein spezialisierter Personalvermittler für Tiefbau, Infrastruktur und Energie im DACH-Raum. Wir arbeiten für Bauunternehmen, Netzbetreiber und Infrastrukturdienstleister, die genau die Fachkräfte suchen, die sonst kaum zu finden sind – und für die Menschen, die diese Baustellen und Netze am Laufen halten.
Wir glauben, dass gute Vermittlung mit Zuhören anfängt: erst verstehen, wen wir vor uns haben, dann passend zusammenbringen. Statt Lebensläufe zu streuen, arbeiten wir gezielt, diskret und partnerschaftlich – auf beiden Seiten.
Trag Dich in unseren Talentpool ein und erzähl uns kurz, wer Du bist und was Du suchst. Wir melden uns, sobald etwas Passendes reinkommt.

Job Summary: Prepares, reviews, and presents Electrical and Instrumentation discipline estimates for specific project proposal activities. Provides estimating assistance and guidance to projects, develops conceptual estimates, and performs cost analysis.

Responsible for assisting in the development of discipline/service estimators, developing, and updating historical databases, and assisting in the development of department procedures. Provides direction to others on project/program level tasks.

This is a full-time remote role with travel to support projects and proposal efforts as needed. #LI-EH1 Major Responsibilities: The following duties are performed with respect to Electrical and Instrumentation Estimate Execution, the process of conducting an evaluation of services and/or capital cost elements of a project or effort as defined by an agreed-upon scope that will be used to make key management decisions: Prepares and reviews capital cost estimates.

Develops productivity analysis of construction operations and verifies results by manpower and crew analysis of work operations by craft. Works with other disciplines and functions to collect all necessary data on scope and quantities to prepare an accurate estimate in specialty discipline areas. Performs analysis on functional input.

Participates in establishing pricing structures to be applied to quantities for estimates. Ensures that estimate is in line with market trends and pricing. Manages variations and changes to base estimate and ensures that implications of changes are evaluated before finalizing the solution.

Influences aspects of the specification in the interests of cost rationalization.

The following duties are performed with respect to Foundation Development, the process of establishing and maintaining technical capabilities for personnel, cost databases and tools: Takes ownership of sections of the estimating database(s) summarizing, updating, and maintaining databases for discipline estimates and historical cost data.

Supports the development of estimating standards and procedures. Generates and retrieves reports in the appropriate software application, understands and summarizes the data in the required presentation for management reviews.

The following duties are performed with respect to Project/Site Management Support, the process of providing support services to projects/sites in the form of external cost analysis and estimate reviews in addition to estimate-to-budget conversions: Prepares cost studies utilizing historical data, statistical analysis and cost and quantity comparisons.

Innovates new techniques as required to meet specific needs. Assists projects in identifying scope deviations. Analyzes cost/price data from suppliers/subcontractors and direct work with the ability to generate comparative data (historical costs and other metrics) as part of the cost/price analysis.

Participates in and contributes to Value Engineering studies.

Education and Experience Requirements: Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 8-10 years of relevant experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience Required Knowledge and Skills: Must be able to complete and pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check including verification of employment and education.

Must be a US citizen per contract support requirements. Significant experience in electrical and instrumentation estimating. Demonstrated advanced understanding of Estimating core processes and procedures.

Extensive knowledge and experience in EPC estimating practices and methods, including demonstrated ability to organize, perform, and present cost estimating products with minimum supervision. Skilled in the preparation of electrical discipline estimates.

In-depth knowledge of project schedules and ability to predict/extrapolate costs curves based on the experience of scheduled activities/cost correlation analysis. Knowledge of craft labor performance, equipment production and derivation of composite craft/category labor rates.

Understanding of charging practices and the relationship of charging practices to commercial terms, invoicing, and profitability. Knowledge of current industry and technical developments. Knowledge of global market pricing for commodities and construction practices.

Ability to negotiate successfully with procurement and vendors and accurately evaluate alternative solutions. Technical and practical comprehension of engineering, procurement and construction methods and techniques. In-depth knowledge of the applicable work processes and systems. Knowledge of administrative and supervisory procedures and practices.

Proficiency in Microsoft software applications (Word, Excel [lookups and pivot tables to analyze large data sets], PowerPoint). Proficiency in estimating applications used for discipline estimates. Skilled in oral and written communication with demonstrated ability to present estimating information to peers and management.

Demonstrated ability to work with people of varied backgrounds and objectives. Preferred Knowledge and Skills Deep technical knowledge and experience in Control Systems and Instrumentation estimating for major process systems and/or power plants. Experience in parametric estimating techniques.

EPC/EPCM/EVMS experience on major infrastructure projects. Experience in estimating for U.S. Government customers. Experience in estimating on nuclear power plants or other nuclear facilities. Intermediate knowledge of the applicable Bechtel processes and systems.

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday
We are recruiting for an established and growing precision engineering and manufacturing business based in Nottingham. The company specialises in the manufacture of high-quality machined components for customers across a range of industries and is now looking to appoint a motivated and detail-oriented Technical Estimator to join its commercial team.
The Role As Technical Estimator, you will play a key role in supporting business growth by preparing accurate and commercially competitive quotations for both new and existing customers.
Working closely with customers, suppliers, production, engineering and sales teams, you will review engineering drawings and technical specifications to assess manufacturing requirements, estimate production costs and prepare quotations that support both customer requirements and business profitability.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in technical estimating, precision engineering or a manufacturing environment who enjoys working with technical information, solving problems and managing multiple quotations.
Key Responsibilities Prepare accurate quotations from customer drawings, specifications and enquiries
Interpret engineering drawings, technical data and customer requirements
Calculate material, machining, tooling, subcontract and labour costs
Liaise with suppliers to obtain quotations for materials and subcontract services
Work closely with production and engineering teams to ensure estimates reflect manufacturing capability
Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency and reduce production costs
Maintain accurate quotation records and customer information
Support the sales team with technical information throughout the quotation process
Build and maintain positive customer and supplier relationships
Respond to quotation requests within agreed timescales
Assist with contract reviews and customer enquiries where required
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the business
About You The successful candidate will be organised, commercially aware and confident working with technical information.
You will have excellent attention to detail, strong numerical and analytical skills, and the ability to manage multiple quotations while working to deadlines. You will also be comfortable communicating with colleagues, customers and suppliers at all levels.
Skills & Experience Essential Previous experience in technical estimating or a manufacturing environment
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
Good understanding of precision engineering and machining processes
Strong numerical and analytical skills
Excellent attention to detail
Good communication and organisational skills
Competent using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
Ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines
Desirable Experience using MRP or ERP systems
Knowledge of CNC machining, fabrication or precision engineering
Experience preparing quotations within a subcontract manufacturing environment
Commercial or customer-facing experience
